title: Model-specific runtime optimizations: Llama/Mistral/Qwen quirks + GQA/MQA tuning
author: Marco Rivera
description: This PR applies a set of targeted runtime optimizations for model-specific quirks observed in Llama, Mistral, and Qwen families and introduces tuning for grouped/merged-quantization (GQA/MQA) execution paths. Motivation: customer workloads showed 8-20% higher per-token latency and increased memory pressure for Qwen-like attention layouts and for MQA-packed checkpoints. Changes include kernel selection heuristics, attention kernel micro-optimizations, KV-cache eviction fixes for long-context workloads, and continuous-batching scheduling heuristics to better pack heterogeneous sequence lengths. The PR also adds a small perf harness and regression tests. Checklist: - [x] Add Qwen attention path optimizations and reorder memory accesses - [x] Improve kernel selection to favor fused GEMM+softmax for short sequences on Ampere/GPU gen - [x] Add GQA/MQA quantization-aware codepaths and micro-benchmarks - [x] Fix KV-cache eviction bug that caused extra memcpy on prefix-heavy workloads - [x] Update continuous batcher to group by effective token-length and model-variant hints - [x] Add unit + integration tests and perf checks - [x] Update changelog and release notes Files changed are limited to runtime, scheduler, kernels, tests, and perf harness. This is strictly a performance and correctness change; no API backwards-incompatible changes are introduced.

review_comments: Samira Patel: Can you add a short note on why the Qwen reordered access improves cache line utilization? Looks good otherwise.
Marco Rivera: Added comments and a short explanation in docs/perf_notes; microbenchmark shows 8-14% improvement for short-seq workloads.
Elliot Chen: The GQA path looks good but please ensure fallback to standard quant kernels for models without packed metadata. Also add a unit test covering that fallback.

Priya Anand: Observed a small regression in tail-latency in dev cluster when batching many long sequences. Could this be due to the new grouping heuristics?

Marco Rivera: Adjusted continuous-batcher to cap grouping window and to prefer draining after a latency threshold; re-ran perf harness, tail-latency returned to baseline while maintaining avg improvement.
release_notes: Performance: Qwen attention kernel reorder reduces median latency for short sequences by 8-14% on Ampere GPUs; GQA/MQA quantization-aware execution provides up to 12% memory reduction and 6-10% throughput improvement for packed checkpoints. Reliability: fixed KV-cache eviction memcpy bug that affected very long-prefix workloads. Ops: new perf harness to reproduce model-specific gains.
